quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue was KRW 78,810,850,520 versus KRW 104,133,821,715 in H1 2025, with an H1 operating loss of KRW 36,437,284,952 (H1 2025: loss of KRW 38,012,900,953). Q2 2026 revenue was KRW 38,831,737,876 (Q2 2025: KRW 56,085,163,295) with a Q2 operating loss of KRW 25,005,727,648. H1 net loss KRW 33,099,335,242. H1 cost of sales included an inventory valuation loss of KRW 25,062,940 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 11,310,685 thousand).

quarterly_data.signal: Product mix, H1 2026: connectors (mobile USB Type-C waterproof interfaces, all made at domestic plant 1) KRW 44,830M or 56.9% of revenue; tempered glass (mobile cover glass, camera windows, automotive and wearable glass, mostly made at the 100% Vietnam subsidiary JNTC VINA) KRW 33,981M or 43.1%. Tempered-glass revenue had fallen to KRW 100,304M in FY2025 (54.0%) from KRW 194,334M in FY2024 as volumes from its Greater-China end customer declined. The new businesses (semiconductor TGV glass substrates and HDD glass platters) are not yet broken out in the revenue table.
quarterly_data.figure: connectors KRW 44,830M (56.9%); tempered glass KRW 33,981M (43.1%); FY2025 tempered glass KRW 100,304M (54.0%)

quarterly_data.signal: TGV glass substrate status: JNTC describes its through-glass-via glass substrate as a next-generation semiconductor package substrate replacing organic substrates and highlighted as a key component for HBM implementation. It has built a mass-production line with a monthly capacity of 10,000 units at its domestic plant 3 and is supplying samples to global customers (no customer named). A dedicated domestic TGV glass substrate plant was completed and started operating in 2025, and the company plans to expand TGV glass substrate lines in stages using the Vietnam plant 4 site. Its R&D lab is developing large-area TGV glass substrates; a patent on high-selectivity through-hole formation by laser modification was registered 2025-11-25.
quarterly_data.figure: TGV mass-production line capacity 10,000 units per month (domestic plant 3); samples to global customers

quarterly_data.signal: HDD glass platter (glass substrate for data-center hard-disk drives): JNTC says it is in the preparation stage for full mass production through its Vietnam subsidiary; JNTC VINA plant 3 is to produce the new HDD glass platter product in 2026. The board approved a change in the scale of the capex for HDD glass platter mass production on 2026-03-19 and a change in its period and scale on 2026-06-30 (amounts not stated in the report).

Capex: H1 2026 cash paid for property, plant and equipment was KRW 65,363,031,560 (H1 2025: KRW 15,123,579,945), mostly overseas additions (Vietnam) of KRW 59,423M; commitments to acquire PP&E stood at KRW 54,285,717 thousand at June 30 versus KRW 13,884,562 thousand at end-2025. PP&E purchased from the parent, factory-automation equipment maker Jinwoo Engineering, totalled KRW 59,926,597 thousand in H1. JNTC injected KRW 52,623,500 thousand of cash into JNTC VINA in H1, and the proceeds of its 2025 exchangeable bond (KRW 12,402M) and March 2026 private bond (KRW 30,000M) were used for production equipment and capacity expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 PP&E acquisitions KRW 65,363,031,560; PP&E commitments KRW 54,285,717 thousand; cash injection into JNTC VINA KRW 52,623,500 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Utilisation, H1 2026: cover-glass capacity at JNTC VINA 51,700 (thousand units) with output of 19,750, a utilisation rate of 38.20% (FY2025: 40.16%; FY2024: 45.10%); connector capacity 21,752 with output 12,729, utilisation 58.52% (FY2025: 50.52%).

Customers: connectors are sold to Samsung Electronics directly and through Samsung Electronics' tier-1 suppliers (USB Type-C 3.2 waterproof sockets applied to the Galaxy S26 and Fold7); camera window glass reaches Samsung Electronics through other suppliers; cover glass is sold through display makers to end customers. Past cover-glass projects named Huawei, Honor, Google and LG. H1 revenue by region: Korea KRW 46,100,970 thousand, China KRW 4,449,445 thousand, Vietnam KRW 8,545,812 thousand, other countries KRW 19,714,624 thousand.
